title: Explicit linear serial EB cutoff for CP, two-copositive maps
status_authority: Completed substantive internal audits at their exact version and scope; source availability and empirical/novelty claims are separate.
reported_status: For every d>=2, every serial word of 2(d-1) complex-linear completely positive maps on M_d whose output-transposed maps are two-positive is entanglement breaking for every finite reference and positive joint input. Factors may differ and need not preserve trace or be unital. The bound is sufficient; optimality is not established.
